NOTICE AND AGENDA
  FOR SPECIAL MEETING

  SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE NORWALK REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY

  DECEMBER 17, 2019

  NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Chair of the Successor Agency to the Norwalk Redevelopment
Agency has called a special meeting at 6:00 p.m. on December 17, 2019 in the City Council Chambers, Norwalk
City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard. The agenda for the special meeting is as follows:

(Members of the public are entitled to speak only on the items listed. Please fill out a speaker card and turn it in
to the Sergeant at Arms before the meeting commences.)

CALL TO ORDER / FLAG SALUTE  Chair Rios

ROLL CALL  Secretary

REPORTS

1. RECOGNIZED OBLIGATION PAYMENT SCHEDULE FOR THE FISCAL PERIOD COMMENCING JULY 1,
  2020 THROUGH JUNE 30, 2021 (“ROPS 20-21”) – Staff recommends the Agency receive and file the
  Recognized Obligation Payment Schedule for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2021.  1310-04

2. PROPOSED ADMINISTRATIVE BUDGETS FOR THE SIX-MONTH FISCAL PERIODS JULY 1, 2020
  THROUGH DECEMBER 31, 2020 AND JANUARY 1, 2021 THROUGH JUNE 30, 2021– Staff recommends
  the Agency receive and file the Administrative Budgets for the six-month fiscal periods July 1, 2020 through
  December 31, 2020 and January 1, 2021 through June 30, 2021.  610

Dated this 12th day of December 2019.

I, Theresa Devoy, Secretary, hereby certify that the foregoing notice of special meeting was posted at City Hall not less than
24-hours before the start of the meeting and delivered to each member of the Norwalk City Council and to the following
newspapers: Herald American, Cerritos Community News, Norwalk Patriot, and Whittier Daily News, all on the 12th day of
December 2019.

Theresa Devoy, CMC, Secretary
Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda after it has been
posted will also be made available for public inspection in the City Clerk’s Department.

Public Comment: The public is encouraged to address the City Council on any matter listed on the agenda.

Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in a City
meeting or other services offered by this City, please contact the City Clerk’s office, (562) 929-5720. Assisted listening
devices are available at this meeting. Ask the City Clerk if you desire to use this device. Upon request, the agenda and
documents in the agenda packet, can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability.
Notification of at least 12 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist the City staff in assuring
that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.

SUBJECT:  RECOGNIZED OBLIGATION PAYMENT SCHEDULE FOR THE FISCAL
  PERIOD COMMENCING JULY 1, 2020 THROUGH JUNE 30, 2021
  (“ROPS 20-21”)

Background:

Attached is the Successor Agency to the Norwalk Redevelopment Agency (“Successor
Agency”) Recognized Obligation Payment Schedule (“ROPS”) for the fiscal year ending
June 30, 2021. Resolution No. OB 20-02 approving ROPS 20-21, which will be presented
before the Los Angeles County Fourth Supervisorial District Consolidated Oversight
Board on January 28, 2020.

Pursuant to Section 34177 of the Health and Safety Code (“HSC”), the Successor Agency
must prepare ROPS annually, listing the anticipated payments for enforceable obligations
to be made from July 1 through the following June 30.

All ROPS must be approved by the Oversight Board. Furthermore, each Oversight
Board-approved ROPS must be submitted to the Department of Finance (DOF) for
review.

The preparation and submittal of ROPS 20-21 are for the purpose of allowing the
Successor Agency to pay its enforceable obligations for the period from July 1, 2020 to
June 30, 2021. HSC Section 34177 requires the Successor Agency to submit an
Oversight Board-approved ROPS 20-21 to the DOF and to the County Auditor-Controller
no later than February 1, 2020.

The DOF may eliminate or modify any item on the ROPS before approving the ROPS.
The DOF must make its determination regarding the enforceable obligations and the
amount and funding source for each enforceable obligation listed on ROPS 20-21 no later
than April 15, 2020. Within five business days of the DOF’s determination, the Successor
Agency may request to “meet and confer” with the DOF on disputed items. The DOF will
issue its final determination after the meet and confer.
 Successor Agency  December 17, 2019
ROPS 20-21  Page No. 2

The County Auditor-Controller is required to make Redevelopment Property Tax Trust
Fund (RPTTF) disbursements to the Successor Agency pursuant to the DOF-approved
ROPS 19-20 on June 1, 2019 (to cover enforceable obligation payments from July 1,
2020 through December 31, 2020) and January 2, 2021 (to cover enforceable obligation
payments from January 1, 2021 through June 30, 2021).

Citizens Advised: N/A

Strategic Action Plan Implementation: N/A

Recommended Action:

Staff recommends the Agency receive and file the Recognized Obligation Payment
Schedule for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2021.

SUBJECT:  PROPOSED ADMINISTRATIVE BUDGETS FOR THE SIX-MONTH
  FISCAL PERIODS JULY 1, 2020 THROUGH DECEMBER 31, 2020 AND
  JANUARY 1, 2021 THROUGH JUNE 30, 2021

Background:

Attached is the Successor Agency to the Norwalk Redevelopment Agency (“Successor
Agency”) proposed Administrative Budgets for the six-month fiscal periods from July 1,
2020 through December 31, 2020 and January 1, 2021 through June 30, 2021.
Resolution OB No. 20-01 approving administrative budgets will be presented before the
Los Angeles County Fourth Supervisorial District Consolidated Oversight Board on
January 28, 2020.

Pursuant to 34177(j) of the California Health and Safety Code (“HSC”), the Successor
Agency is required to prepare a proposed administrative budget for each six-month fiscal
period, which must be submitted to the Oversight Board for approval and the total
administrative budget covering the entire fiscal year cannot exceed $250,000. Each
proposed administrative budget must include all of the following: (1) estimated amounts
for Successor Agency administrative costs for the applicable six-month fiscal period;
(2) proposed sources of payment for the administrative costs; and (3) proposals for
arrangements for administrative and operations services provided by the City of Norwalk
or another entity.

The attached administrative budget covering the entire fiscal year 2020/21 complies with
the above listed requirements.
